classification.difficultyReason: Simplifies a ratio of adjacent coefficients and transforms a product before finding its constant term.

children.label: a
children.prompt: In the expansion of $(2+3x)^n$, the coefficients of $x^5$ and $x^6$ are in the ratio $4:9$. Find the value of $n$.

answer.worked:
The coefficients of $x^5$ and $x^6$ are ${}^{n}C_5\,2^{n-5}3^5$ and ${}^{n}C_6\,2^{n-6}3^6$, respectively.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{{}^{n}C_5\,2^{n-5}3^5}{{}^{n}C_6\,2^{n-6}3^6}&=\frac49\\\frac{{}^{n}C_5}{{}^{n}C_6}\cdot\frac23&=\frac49\\\frac{6}{n-5}\cdot\frac23&=\frac49\\\frac4{n-5}&=\frac49\\n-5&=9\\n&=14\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: In the expansion of $\left(x+\frac1x\right)^{40}\left(x-\frac1x\right)^{40}$, find the term independent of $x$. Give your answer in the form ${}^{n}C_r$, and also correct to four significant figures.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\left(x+\frac1x\right)^{40}\left(x-\frac1x\right)^{40}&=\left(x^2-\frac1{x^2}\right)^{40}
\end{align*}$$
Using the general term indexed by $r=0,1,\ldots,40$:
$$\begin{align*}T_r&={}^{40}C_r(x^2)^{40-r}(-x^{-2})^r\\&={}^{40}C_r(-1)^r x^{80-4r}\end{align*}$$
For the constant term,
$$\begin{align*}80-4r&=0\\r&=20\\T_{20}&={}^{40}C_{20}(-1)^{20}\\&={}^{40}C_{20}\\&=137846528820\\&\approx1.378\times10^{11}\quad\text{(4 significant figures).}\end{align*}$$
